a_before_b.rationale: Identifying scalability bottlenecks in evaluation does not require prior mastery of selecting evaluation methods and curating data sets; one can recognize cost, time, and annotation-standardization problems without knowing how to design evaluation methods.

b_before_a.rationale: Selecting evaluation methods and curating data sets can be done meaningfully without first understanding scalability bottlenecks caused by high costs, time requirements, and lack of standardization in human annotation.
